h1: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kulti

h1Text: Outdoor Playground Equipment Manufacturer & Supplier in Kulti

items.pText: Kulti grew up around steel works and coal mines in the Asansol belt of West Bengal, and many of its neighbourhoods are older company colonies. Some still have play areas from decades ago, with rusted swings and broken concrete that are no longer safe. FunPlay Systems manufactures new outdoor playground equipment in Vasai, near Mumbai, and sends it about 1,520 km by road to the Asansol area.

If you are replacing an old playground, send us photos of what is there now, along with the size of the ground and the ages of the children who use it. We will suggest what to remove, what to install and where the safe play area should go. Installation is handled by our own team or a dealer in eastern India.

props.h2Text: How would you like to start?
props.pText: Turn your playground dreams to reality

c: Before new equipment goes in, the old footings, broken slabs and protruding bolts must come out, because they become trip hazards inside the new safe zone. Hard, compacted ground in the mining belt usually suits grouted installation, with each post set in concrete.

items.q: Can you replace an old, rusted playground in Kulti?
items.a: Yes. Send photos of the existing equipment and the ground. We will suggest a new layout, and the old footings should be cleared before our team or dealer installs the new pieces.

items.q: Which installation method suits hard ground?
items.a: Grouting, where each post is set in concrete, is usually best on compacted or rocky soil. Self-standing installation suits sites where digging is not possible.

items.q: How long is the warranty on new equipment?
items.a: Three years on galvanised pipes, roto-moulded parts, composite laminates and play rope, and one year on springs, bearings and spare parts, covering manufacturing defects.
